source.accepted_proposal: /mnt/project-files/data-part/MP按数据接入_建议_20261008.md: the objective selects profiles (DR, unchanged); dataset labels decide which conditions of the selected profiles apply (host checklist, decided by DC-review); data never create requirements, and data no requirement uses are routed to human review.

library_changes: Every profile gains data_roles (label roles whose data it can use) and condition_triggers: one trigger per conditional input and data check. Profile text is unchanged.

Trigger = labels (field -> allowed values; empty means every linked dataset) + review (NONE, OBJECTIVE or DATA). Triggers are a project-designed mapping, pending the same scientific review as the profile text.
label_changes: DC labels add role values URINE_EXCRETION, IN_VITRO_CLEARANCE, REPORTED_PARAMETERS, ANIMAL_CHARACTERISTICS; categorical route_category, matrix_category, record_category, observation_source (with MIXED and NOT_FOUND); and dose_basis and analyte as stated by the source. Existing free-text fields are kept.
code_changes: method_profiles.py: LABEL_CATEGORIES, TRIGGER schema, applicability(), condition_checklist(), unrequested_profiles(); the current menu must carry triggers, frozen snapshots without them stay readable and yield no checklist rows.

data_agents.py: label schema and instructions; DC-review receives condition_checklist and returns condition_checks; host check_conditions() verifies ids, evidence and that label-confirmed rows are not excluded; METHOD_CONDITION_GAP and DATA_FITS_UNREQUESTED_METHOD findings are FOLLOW_UP; adequacy/condition_checklist.json is written and referenced from adequacy.json.
Tests: test_method_profiles.py adds 8 cases; test_data_agents.py fixture supplies the new label fields and condition decisions.
verification: research_pipeline suite: 18 failed, 512 passed, 7 skipped, 2 errors; identical failure list to the pre-change baseline (environment: no R).
not_done: Condition gaps are not yet carried through the G008 ledger to DH handoffs; that belongs to the planned ledger work.
